title: From the Caves and Jungles of Hindostan
summary: "From the Caves and Jungles of Hindostan" by H. P. Blavatsky is a literary work published in serial installments from 1879 to 1886. Written as letters from India to Russian periodicals, this travelogue blends vivid descriptions of Indian landscapes and ancient temples with accounts of mysterious yogis performing apparent miracles. Blavatsky explores Indian spiritual traditions while offering sharp criticism of British colonial rule. The unfinished series achieved stunning success in Russia, though later critics questioned the reliability of her fantastical narratives, calling the work an imaginative mixture of fact and fiction.
